title: Enhancement: [sflow] Remove unnecessary 'config reload' call
author: anders-nexthop
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

There is an extra `config reload` call in the test setup that was added to work around [sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/2665](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/2665), but was not removed in [sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/2847](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/2847). The test runs fine without this reload, and it saves 5 minutes of test time to remove it: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/blob/4082f1c4ed254713508e2908dc3a84c74a81b6af/tests/sflow/test_sflow.py#L124

### Current Behavior

test_sflow.py calls 'config reload' during test setup.

### Proposed Behavior

test_sflow.py does not call 'config reload' during test setup.

Summary:
There is an extra 'config reload' call in the test_sflow.py test setup code. It was added as a workaround for a bug that was filed in 2019, and the workaround was supposed to have been removed in 2021, but the commend and the 'config reload' call are still there. The test passes fine without it, and it adds several minutes of overhead.

Closes [#22187](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/21187)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Speed up the test by removing outdated workaround.
#### How did you do it?
Remove the `config save`/`config reload` and the associated comment. I left the `sleep()` call in place, we should clean up the test timing separately.
#### How did you verify/test it?
